summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by checking if the timezone object has a 'zone' attribute and returning it, which seems to resolve the reverse time zone conversion problem for specific time zones like 'Etc/GMT-10'. However, it may not cover all edge cases or other time zone implementations.

issues.description: The patch assumes that all timezone objects will have a 'zone' attribute, which may not be true for all timezone implementations. This could lead to functional incompleteness if other timezone objects do not have this attribute.
The change might introduce behavioral regression risk if other timezone implementations do not have a 'zone' attribute, leading to unexpected behavior or errors.
